old: Controls stay crisp and familiar, close to native desktop controls; the terminal look belongs to identity, headings, and commands, not to every surface.
new: Controls use soft depth and familiar shapes; the terminal look belongs to identity, headings, and commands, not to every surface.

old: Its pressed option is a thumb inset 2px inside the button, with `--radius-sm` corners, a 1px `--border` ring for 3:1 against the track, and a fill lighter than the track: `--surface-raised` in light, and in dark `--text` mixed 10% into the track, because the dark raised surface is darker than the track.
new: Its pressed option is a pill thumb inset 2px inside the button, with `--shadow-raise` and no ring: `--surface-raised` in light, and that surface mixed 88% with white in dark. The pressed label or icon takes `--accent`, measured at least 3:1 against the thumb.

old: A segmented control is an undivided `--surface-hover` track with no visible outer border; a transparent 1px border keeps its size and shows in forced colors.
new: A segmented control is an undivided `--field` track with `--shadow-sink` and no visible outer border; a transparent 1px border keeps its size and shows in forced colors.

old: Callouts add a faint status border.
new: Callouts use the status tint without a visible border; keep a transparent 1px border for forced colors.

old: Status badges are tinted pills whose text is the status color mixed with `--text`, so the level reads at a glance; a neutral badge keeps a `--border-subtle` edge.
new: Status badges are pills with a 22% status tint over `--surface-raised`, text mixed 75% with `--text` in light and 85% in dark, and a leading 6px dot; neutral badges have no visible border or dot.

old: | Well | Source code, screenshots, figures, and inset previews | `--surface` | `--border-subtle` | `--radius-lg` | None |
new: | Well | Source code, screenshots, figures, and inset previews | `--surface` | Source code: transparent 1px; figures: `--border-subtle` | `--radius-lg` | Source code: `--shadow-raise`; figures: none |

old: | Panel | Cards, forms, charts, and detail views | `--surface-raised` | `--border-subtle` | `--radius-lg` | None |
new:
| Panel | Cards, forms, charts, and detail views | `--surface-raised` | Transparent 1px | `--radius-lg` | `--shadow-raise` |
  | Field | Inputs, selects, segmented and switch tracks, and selected radio cards | `--field` | Transparent 1px; switch keeps `--border` | Controls: `--radius-md`; radio cards: `--radius-lg` | `--shadow-sink` |

old: | Terminal plate | Command lines and terminal captures, in both themes | `--terminal` | `--terminal-border` | `--radius-lg` | None |
new: | Terminal plate | Command lines and terminal captures, in both themes | `--terminal` | `--terminal-border` | `--radius-lg` | Commands: `--shadow-raise`; captures: none |

old: `--border` is for control edges only: buttons, inputs, and selects. Panels, wells, and dividers use `--border-subtle`.
new: `--border` keeps unchecked checkbox and radio edges visible, and outlines the switch track. Buttons, fields, panels, and radio cards keep transparent 1px borders for forced colors; invalid fields show a `--danger` edge. Figures and dividers use `--border-subtle`.

old: Radii are small and crisp: `--radius-sm` (3px) for inline elements; `--radius-md` (4px) for controls and rows; `--radius-lg` (6px) for wells, plates, panels, callouts, and floating layers. `--radius-pill` is for status badges and switch tracks only.
new: Radii are soft: `--radius-sm` (6px) for inline elements, checkboxes, and navigation rows; `--radius-md` (999px) for pill controls; `--radius-lg` (16px) for wells, plates, panels, radio cards, callouts, and floating layers. Inner menu rows derive their radius from the panel radius minus `--space-1`. Status badges and switch tracks use `--radius-pill`.

old: Shadows belong to floating layers. Modest radii and stable hover states keep normal content quiet.
new: `--shadow-raise` gives panels, source code, command plates, and segmented thumbs soft depth; `--shadow-sink` insets fields and tracks. Floating layers keep `--shadow-popover`. Stable hover states keep normal content quiet.

old: Buttons: one clearly primary action per visible decision group; secondary actions are quieter. Touch controls use `--control-lg`.
new: Buttons: pill shapes, with one clearly primary action per visible decision group. Secondary actions use `--surface-hover` without a visible border; hover mixes 8% `--text` into the fill. Touch controls use `--control-lg`. Inputs and selects use `--field` and `--shadow-sink`. Radio cards rise when unselected and sink when selected, with an accent check badge instead of an accent ring.

old: Draw keyboard focus as `outline: 2px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 2px`; the `tokens.css` base sets it.
new: Library controls draw keyboard focus as a 2px outline of `--accent` mixed 80% with transparent, offset 2px, plus a 6px accent halo at 18% via `box-shadow`, added to the existing raise or sink shadow. Links and site navigation keep `outline: 2px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 2px`; the `tokens.css` base sets it.

old: Do not draw focus with `box-shadow`: forced-colors mode removes it.
new: The outline is always present so forced colors keep it; the halo only adds to it.

old: tinted wells, pill-shaped buttons or cards, and hover lifts.
new: decoratively tinted wells, pill-shaped cards, and hover lifts.
